sentences.text: Thoraxion measured roughly 6 metres from head to tail.
Its genus name comes from the Ancient Greek term for ribcage, highlighting the animal’s relatively compact thoracic region.
The species name honors Tahlequah, a southern resident orca noted for complex emotional behaviours such as mourning its calves.
Over fifty mosasaur specimens were recovered from 19th-century chalk quarries in the Mons Basin, many previously assigned to Mosasaurus lemonnieri.
Small vertebrae found in the abdominal cavity represent preserved gut contents, indicating the animal’s recent meals.
Thoraxion belongs to the tribe Mosasaurini, a group of mosasaurine mosasaurs that lived during the Maastrichtian of the Late Cretaceous.
Phylogenetic studies place it after Prognathodon and Eremiasaurus but before the more derived Mosasaurus lineage.
